subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The session-key bug is mechanical, but the PR creates a new public Gateway surface and optional ContextEngine plugin contract with admin rotate behavior, which needs maintainer API/product intent.

options.title: Approve after session fix
options.body: Keep the proposed API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first API
options.body: Land only read-scoped capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that operator action.

options.title: Defer to plugins
options.body: Pause or close the core PR and keep context-engine maintenance control on plugin/private surfaces until a broader Gateway control contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve after session fix
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman has the strongest current history signal for the ContextEngine plugin contract that this PR extends.
